crop.notes: Top of the Real Estate Transfers list including the Allen line; the list continues below the crop but nothing more about Allen is needed.

ocr.notes: Many names and figures garbled or dropped: 'Wash; Geo. O'Neil to Bertha Dahm', '50 ft.' / '175 ft.' sizes, 'KEOKUK' read as 'PONCE', most dollar amounts missing. The Allen line is right: GEYER, 50 ft., s. s., bet. Ninth and Tenth; Tom Allen to Henry Steinmeyer, w. d., $2,500.

title.suggested: Tom Allen sells Geyer Avenue lot

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic's real estate transfers listed a deed from Tom Allen to Henry Steinmeyer for 50 feet on the south side of Geyer Avenue, between Ninth and Tenth, for $2,500.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic, Friday, February 1, 1901, page 10.

facts.fact: A Tom Allen sold 50 feet on the south side of Geyer Avenue, between Ninth and Tenth, to Henry Steinmeyer for $2,500
places: Geyer Avenue between Ninth and Tenth, St. Louis

notes: Nothing in the listing says this Tom Allen is the boxer; it could be another man of the same name. Fact date is the listing date; the deed date is not given.
